content.title: AORT Q2 Deep Dive: Product Momentum and Pipeline Advances Drive Upgraded Guidance
content.summary: Medical device company Artivion (NYSE:AORT) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales up 15.3% year on year to $113 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $439 million at the midpoint came in 2.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.24 per share was 92% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Artivion price target raised to $45 from $32 at Needham
content.summary: Needham analyst Mike Matson raised the firm’s price target on Artivion (AORT) to $45 from $32 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares.
